newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKEY TO PUT EREGLI SHARES ON SALE BY END-1996.
newsitem.headline: TURKEY TO PUT EREGLI SHARES ON SALE BY END-1996.

text.p: Turkey's Privatisation Administration (OIB) will put state shares in iron and steel maker Eregli on sale by the end of this year, a senior OIB official said.
"We will go for a tender by the end of this year," Ismail Karakaya, acting chairman, told Reuters.
The government has a 51.66 percent stake in the partially privatised Eregli.
The OIB had invited bids for the state share in Eregli last year but later postponed the tender to allow more time for potential investors to make bids.
Karakaya said the High Board of Privatisation would issue a decree soon, enabling the OIB to start the tender process.
"The decree will also draw up the content of a golden share in Eregli," he said.
